periods.time: Hospital viewing during Stella's B-block match
periods.label: 腥红淑女的反射术士证言

status.current: recovering/visiting Touka while watching Seven Stars broadcast

personality.summary: Gentle and guilt-ridden over Hagun's injuries, but candid about enemy strength and grateful for Stella's revenge.
fears: Stella's kindness pushing her into danger

relationships.toka-todo: Watches the match with Touka and discusses tournament prospects in the hospital.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Feels grateful but pained because Stella risks herself to avenge injured Hagun students.
relationships.yui-tatara: Former opponent during the Hagun attack; Kanata failed to leave even a scratch because of Tatara's reflection.
relationships.utakata-misogi: Present when he wakes and urgently asks about the tournament.

periods.summary: Kanata watches Stella's B-block battle from Touka's hospital room and explains that Stella's four-on-one challenge is an act of kindness toward the Hagun students wounded by Akatsuki. Her own experience fighting Yui Tatara during the school attack lets her identify Tatara as a reflection mage; even Diamond Dust, which can infiltrate lungs as microscopic blade fragments, could not harm Tatara. Kanata's testimony frames the danger Stella faces. After Stella wins, Kanata acknowledges that her guilt had made her underestimate Stella's strength and later assists when Utakata wakes.

key_events.summary: Tells Touka that Tatara's reflection made Kanata unable to scratch her.
Confirms Utakata has been asleep for more than a week and hears his warning.
